<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  
  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="22" y="24" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#121212">9:41</text>
    <line x1="310" y1="17" x2="310" y2="23" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="315" y1="14" x2="315" y2="23" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="320" y1="11" x2="320" y2="23" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="337" cy="18" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <line x1="334" y1="14" x2="340" y2="14" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="1.4"/>
    <rect x="354" y="12" width="23" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="357" y="15" width="16" height="6" rx="1.5" fill="#5DB329"/>
    <rect x="378" y="16" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#121212"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Header -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="31" cy="61" r="16" fill="#D4FCBC"/>
    <circle cx="25" cy="57" r="5" fill="#5DB329"/>
    <circle cx="36" cy="55" r="4" fill="#4B9460"/>
    <ellipse cx="31" cy="67" rx="10" ry="5" fill="#5DB329"/>
    <text x="56" y="67" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="24" font-weight="500" fill="#0A2533">mint</text>
    <line x1="24" y1="94" x2="366" y2="94" stroke="#E6EBF2" stroke-width="1"/>
    <rect x="24" y="105" width="72" height="5" rx="2.5" fill="#5DB329"/>
    <rect x="100" y="105" width="72" height="5" rx="2.5" fill="#E6EBF2"/>
    <rect x="176" y="105" width="72" height="5" rx="2.5" fill="#E6EBF2"/>
    <rect x="252" y="105" width="114" height="5" rx="2.5" fill="#E6EBF2"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Main copy -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="154" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="26" font-weight="500" fill="#0A2533">How will you use mint?</text>
    <text x="24" y="183" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">Choose the experience that fits you best.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Customer card shadow and card -->
  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="215" width="342" height="169" rx="10" fill="#063336" opacity="0.10"/>
    <rect x="24" y="213" width="342" height="169" rx="10" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <rect x="42" y="232" width="74" height="74" rx="10" fill="#F3FAF6"/>
    <circle cx="79" cy="254" r="13" fill="#ADD993"/>
    <ellipse cx="79" cy="282" rx="23" ry="13" fill="#5DB075"/>
    <circle cx="74" cy="253" r="2" fill="#0A2533"/>
    <circle cx="84" cy="253" r="2" fill="#0A2533"/>
    <line x1="74" y1="263" x2="84" y2="263" stroke="#0A2533" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="134" y="249" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="500" fill="#0A2533">Customer</text>
    <text x="134" y="274" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">Discover homemade meals</text>
    <text x="134" y="294" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">from cooks in your community.</text>
    <circle cx="342" cy="237" r="11" fill="#5DB329"/>
    <polyline points="337,237 341,241 348,233" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <line x1="42" y1="327" x2="348" y2="327" stroke="#E6EBF2" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="42" y="354" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#5DB329">ORDER • TRACK • REVIEW</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Kitchen owner card -->
  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="405" width="342" height="169" rx="10" fill="#063336" opacity="0.10"/>
    <rect x="24" y="403" width="342" height="169" rx="10" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <rect x="42" y="422" width="74" height="74" rx="10" fill="#FFF8E8"/>
    <rect x="55" y="466" width="48" height="16" rx="3" fill="#5DB075"/>
    <polygon points="53,466 105,466 96,451 62,451" fill="#4B9460"/>
    <rect x="68" y="438" width="22" height="14" rx="2" fill="#ADD993"/>
    <line x1="72" y1="445" x2="86" y2="445" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="134" y="439" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="500" fill="#0A2533">Kitchen owner</text>
    <text x="134" y="464" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">Share your homemade food</text>
    <text x="134" y="484" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">and grow your local community.</text>
    <circle cx="342" cy="427" r="11" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#C7C7C7" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="337" y1="427" x2="347" y2="427" stroke="#C7C7C7" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="342" y1="422" x2="342" y2="432" stroke="#C7C7C7" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="42" y1="517" x2="348" y2="517" stroke="#E6EBF2" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="42" y="544" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#4B9460">CREATE • SELL • CONNECT</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Continue button -->
  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="602" width="342" height="60" rx="10" fill="#063336" opacity="0.10"/>
    <rect x="24" y="600" width="342" height="60" rx="10" fill="#5DB329"/>
    <text x="195" y="637" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Continue</text>
    <polyline points="292,630 299,637 292,644" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  </g>

  <text x="195" y="694" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">You can change this later in Settings</text>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="758" width="390" height="86" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="758" x2="390" y2="758" stroke="#E6EBF2" stroke-width="1"/>
    <g>
      <polygon points="38,784 49,775 60,784 60,798 39,798" fill="none" stroke="#97A2B0" stroke-width="2"/>
      <polyline points="34,784 49,771 64,784" fill="none" stroke="#97A2B0" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="49" y="820" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#97A2B0">Home</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <circle cx="127" cy="785" r="10" fill="none" stroke="#97A2B0" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="134" y1="793" x2="141" y2="800" stroke="#97A2B0" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="127" y="820" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#97A2B0">Discover</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <rect x="202" y="776" width="22" height="17" rx="5" fill="none" stroke="#97A2B0" stroke-width="2"/>
      <polygon points="207,793 211,798 214,793" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#97A2B0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <circle cx="208" cy="784" r="1.5" fill="#97A2B0"/>
      <circle cx="213" cy="784" r="1.5" fill="#97A2B0"/>
      <circle cx="218" cy="784" r="1.5" fill="#97A2B0"/>
      <text x="213" y="820" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#97A2B0">Messages</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <circle cx="312" cy="780" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#5DB329" stroke-width="2"/>
      <circle cx="312" cy="777" r="2.5" fill="#5DB329"/>
      <ellipse cx="312" cy="788" rx="7" ry="4" fill="none" stroke="#5DB329" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="312" y="820" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#5DB329">Profile</text>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
